reason: Both give a similar plan and both prompt the Dentrix-training fact, but A has the letter state the gap plainly (caring for her mother, who died last spring, now ready for full-time work) and lead with the $38,000-to-$9,000 figure, which suits an owner who is undecided about gaps.
